MANDATORY T19 DELTA: Build a substantial SHARED LOADING HALL attached along the lower RIGHT SIDE. A broad new copper barrel-vault roof on thick cream-and-timber perimeter columns spans BOTH side dock bays as one covered loading chamber. This is a new tall covered architectural volume with an unmistakable curved copper roof, not a recolor of the existing small front canopy. Keep its outer side partly open so the side dock connections remain visible. Preserve both tall rear logistics towers, lower round bridge, the three-storey front barn, BOTH original front loading doors, and the long BLUE SOLAR monitor strip. The new hall stays below the barn eaves and does not hide the original front face. Frame slightly wider so the entire expanded asset has clear margins.

MANDATORY SOLAR CONTINUITY: Keep clearly visible BLUE PHOTOVOLTAIC PANEL ARRAYS from the accepted previous image, especially the long blue panel strip on top of the central raised clerestory roof monitor. The arrays must remain blue panels with restrained pale cell lines, not turn into corrugated metal. Retain this solar roof assembly through every later expansion. Moving panels onto equally broad integrated upper roof surfaces is allowed only if they stay plainly visible. Never remove all solar panels. 

PERSISTENT FARM-WAREHOUSE GEOMETRY: Image 5 is authoritative for current accumulated geometry. Preserve BOTH original full-width front dispatch door bays from T02 with their solid central dividing pier. These are TWO separate warehouse vehicle-width doorways, not two leaves of one doorway. Keep their positions and the separate right rounded personnel/dispatch annex. Never merge or remove either bay. Only add the current listed upgrade; do not introduce later roof monitors, solar roofs or towers early. 

REFERENCE PRIORITY: image 4 (the accepted T01 asset) defines the exact family DNA, FRONT and shape language. Image 5, when supplied, is the accepted immediate predecessor. Images 1-3 are MATERIAL/PALETTE inspiration only; NEVER copy their whole buildings, props, layout or lighting. Render exactly the current tier described below, not the style-reference scene. Never add boxes, crates, loose props or extra symbols. All lamps OFF, all glass non-emissive, no glow. Thick rounded clean forms, broad painted color areas.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one final Meshy image-to-3D building reference for Weedtopia Inc / Burning Hills.
Subject: rural dispatch warehouse, T19_L1750. Exact visible state: copper-roofed shared loading hall.
Family DNA: broad barn gable, deep shipping door, rounded side dispatch head. Function: rural dispatch warehouse.
Progression: Preserve the T01 family DNA and the previously accepted tier. Integrate previous functional capacity compactly upward and rearward, inside the reserved parcel. Current cumulative architectural milestones: repaired barn with one dispatch door; second broad dispatch door; deep covered loading bay; rear garage wing without vehicles; raise the plaster main storage hall and add a broad continuous clerestory roof monitor above its barn ridge; second covered dock block; broad rounded dispatch loft; continuous solar roof; tall enamel storage section; side stacked dock block; large rear high-bay storage core; second storage storey; broad automated dispatch wing; second rear high-bay storage core; rounded central dispatch bridge; third storage storey; tall compact logistics tower; coupled second logistics tower; copper-roofed shared loading hall. No separate freestanding buildings: all wings and modules are structurally attached.
Scale: maximum reserved parcel 22m local X by 18m local Z, maximum family height 26m. This reserved envelope is NOT a visible base. See asset_spec.de.md for this tier's approximate occupied dimensions; render the whole current object, not an empty full-size plot.
Front and camera: local +Y up, front facing +Z, front stays on the lower-left visible face of the image, local +X side on lower-right. Camera at local (+X,+Y,+Z), about 35 degrees elevated, near orthographic 3/4 front view. Never mirror. Ground-center pivot intent; future growth is upward and toward local -Z. The entry and delivery zones stay on +Z.
Materials: reclaimed wood, cream plaster, aged metal, sage enamel; epoch treatment: oxidized copper, thick green glass, cream plaster, compact solar technology. Broad hand-painted color areas and large restrained wear patches. Rounded/beveled silhouettes, thick reconstructable parts, modular retro technology, one or at most two eventual material slots. Green glass must be thick and legible. At most one dominant botanical or grinder motif.
Reference input roles: Image 1 Reclaimed Green Haven gives warm rebuilt shapes and readability; image 2 Herbal Atom Age gives rounded enamel machines and copper/brass; image 3 Burning Hills Afterglow gives hopeful worldbuilding only, NOT its dusk lighting, environment or people. Additional inputs, when present: the family's accepted T01 geometry anchor, then its immediately preceding accepted tier. Preserve their family identity, front and proportions while making the specified large upgrade visible. For T00 use only the intact T01 as extra geometry reference. For T01 or T_FIXED only the three style inputs are supplied.
Composition: exactly one single complete freestanding asset, centered and grounded; square 1024x1024 or larger, generous 10 percent clear margin all around. Plain solid very light warm-gray/off-white background. Neutral even studio light; one soft contact shadow only. All geometry entirely visible.
Technical intent: stylized game-ready smart-topology, clean edges, minimal geometry; no floating parts. Attached architectural planting is allowed; no loose props. A park may contain its intrinsic bounded planted parcel, never a surrounding scenic diorama.
Exclude: people, characters, vehicles, conveyor belts, surrounding scene, landscape, city, unrelated buildings, loose props, diorama ground, text, readable signs, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI, weapons, gore, smoking, smoke, particles, thin antennae, tangled cables, clipped or cropped geometry, baked dramatic shadows, glows, fog or dusk color casts.
